decisions.text: type stacked_area: fractions or rough subtotals over time, and the total's change matters: absolute stacks, areas, the overall pattern of change being the point (G1.44, G1.45)
stacking order from the base: East, West, South, North (the largest at the base, where it is read precisely; G7.31, D-26 (b))
each part in one colour and one place in every total: East (slot 1), West (slot 2), South (slot 4), North (slot 3) (G4.22, G7.31)
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$100K in donations”
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)

each empty slot's note, wrapped first (owner, 1 Oct 2026): May 2022: step 1, wrapped in its empty slot on the baseline, on 2 lines (the names' break rules, G2.4; step 2 only with nothing beneath the axis's labels)
the unit phrase on the top label: “$100K in donations”; the top gridline starts after it
each part named beside the last period, level with the middle of its band, top to bottom as stacked: North, South, West, East (G5.4, D-31 (c))

source.shows: a look-up chart with a descriptive title (G8.2); North's May not known: the stack is not drawn there, since where the bands above North start is not known either; every band breaks round May, and the note names the part (R0-12, R9-7, G0.16)
